title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SOBRE A LETS

A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com conhecimentos em vendas e na plataforma do HubSpot , apaixonada por resultados, métricas e empresas em pleno crescimento a LET'S é o seu lugar!

SOBRE A VAGA

Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR — Sales Development Representative para impulsionar a geração de demanda e criação de pipeline comercial em contas B2B (médio e enterprise). Você será responsável por prospecção outbound, qualificação de leads inbound, agendamento de reuniões qualificadas (SQLs) e pelo handoff fluido para o time de Vendas (AEs) .

No dia a dia, usará HubSpot (Sales/Marketing Hub) para rodar cadências multicanal (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), segmentar listas, personalizar abordagens por ICP/persona e operar um processo data-driven com SLAs de resposta (lead response time) , taxas de conversão e show rate sob acompanhamento constante. Trabalhará em sintonia com Marketing (ABM, campanhas e conteúdo) e com Vendas (territórios, critérios de passagem, feedbacks de qualidade).

ATIVIDADES

  • Inbound: atender leads rapidamente ( SLA de minutos ), qualificar (BANT/CHAMP/MEDDICC-lite), registrar contexto e agendar reunião com AE.
  • Outbound: construir listas por ICP/persona, pesquisa de conta/decisores , rodar cadências no HubSpot (e-mail, call, WhatsApp/LinkedIn), personalizando mensagens e hipóteses de dor/valor.
  • ABM & personalização: trabalhar contas-alvo junto do Marketing (páginas ABM/Webflow, conteúdos e ofertas), adaptando pitch por segmento (varejo, last-mile, marketplaces B2B).
  • Qualificação & handoff: aplicar critérios claros de passagem (fit, timing, dor, potencial), registrar notas/objetivos próximos passos e garantir handoff sem fricção.
  • Métricas & rotina: controlar LRT, taxa de resposta, reuniões marcadas, show rate, SQLs , pipeline criado e conversões por etapa/canal; sugerir testes de assunto, templates e cadências.
  • CRM disciplina: manter HubSpot atualizado (propriedades, atividades, próximos passos), gerir tasks, listas e sequences com organização exemplar.
  • Feedback de mercado: coletar sinais (objeções, concorrentes, requisitos), produzir insights para Vendas, Marketing e Produto; fechar o loop com aprendizados.
  • Compliance & boas práticas: seguir políticas de opt-in/opt-out, LGPD , UTMs e qualidade de dados em todas as interações.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada (2+ anos) como SDR/BDR em SaaS B2B ou soluções complexas (ciclo consultivo).
  • Domínio de HubSpot (Sales Hub) no dia a dia (lists, sequences, tasks, deals, snippets, playbooks, relatórios básicos).
  • Prospecção outbound e qualificação inbound aplicando BANT ou CHAMP (ou equivalente) e perguntas consultivas (SPIN) ; cadências multicanal no HubSpot (e-mail, ligação, WhatsApp/LinkedIn) com disciplina de CRM.
  • Escrita clara e persuasiva (frio → quente), comunicação verbal confiante para ligações.
  • Organização e disciplina de CRM (registro de atividades, follow-ups, prazos).
  • Foco em metas (reuniões/SQLs/pipeline criado) e melhoria contínua via dados.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de materiais, e-mails e benchmarks.
  • Diferencial forte (não eliminatório): certificações HubSpot (Sales Software/Inbound) ou trilhas concluídas na HubSpot Academy/LinkedIn Learning.

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS

  • Vivência em empesas de software (SaaS) ; logística/last-mile, varejo ou marketplaces B2B .
  • Experiência com LinkedIn Sales Navigator , ferramentas de prospecção (Apollo/Lusha/Hunter) e WhatsApp Business integrado ao HubSpot.
  • MEDDICC-lite/Challenger , ABM com mapeamento de decisores/buying committee, Sales Navigator , testes A/B de cadências/assuntos e co-criação de playbooks com AEs/Marketing.
  • Noções de ABM (contas-alvo, buying committee, mensagens por persona).
  • Integrações e automações com n8n ; familiaridade com Webflow ↔ HubSpot .
  • Espanhol básico é um plus.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados.
  • Comissão direta sobre as vendas.
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).

DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .
  • Como se destacar: envie links das certificações HubSpot , cases mensuráveis (ex.: ganho de conversão, redução de LRT, melhora de deliverability), prints/redashboards e uma breve descrição de arquiteturas de objetos/pipelines que você implementou e; faça os cursos dentro da HubSpot Academy ou no próprio LinkedIn comprovando seus conhecimentos.

title: video maker

Vaga: Videomaker Pleno (Presencial) — Indústria Visual

Um dia comum pode virar história.

Aqui na indústria Visual, a gente acredita que uma câmera ligada e uma ideia honesta conseguem mudar a forma como as pessoas veem nossa marca — e até como elas se sentem. Se você edita com o mesmo ritmo com que pensa, e pensa com o mesmo cuidado com que conta histórias, vem fazer parte do nosso time.

Estamos crescendo e queremos seguir elevando nosso conteúdo a outro patamar: dos Reels que geram conversa aos institucionais que nos orgulham; dos bastidores que aproximam, aos anúncios e campanhas que performam. title: Web Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ English fluency is a must for this role ⚠️

⚠️A challenge will be required ⚠️

Who We Are

Hey there! We’re Uitify, a creative design studio delivering premium UI/UX and branding for early-stage SaaS startups in the US. We help founders turn vision into beautifully functional design. If you're all about detail, innovation, and creating modern digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Senior Web Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and build high-converting, visually stunning websites. You’ll own web projects from idea to execution, working closely with founders, marketers, and our internal design team. If you’re a Framer expert, know how to design for impact, and care about both beauty and usability—we want you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build standout websites using Framer (bonus: Webflow skills);
  • Collaborate with clients to understand goals and translate them into compelling web experiences;
  • Work closely with UX/UI and branding to ensure cohesion across touchpoints;
  • Build landing pages, homepages, product pages, and more;
  • Help evolve and maintain web design systems and components;
  • Optimize sites for responsiveness, performance, and accessibility;
  • Stay on top of design trends and share what you learn with the team.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong English skills (you’ll be in calls with US clients);
  • 10+ years of experience in web design, especially for SaaS or tech;
  • Killer portfolio with websites that show your visual and technical chops;
  • Solid knowledge of Framer (must-have), Figma, Illustrator, and Photoshop;
  • A passion for sleek, clean, and functional design;
  • Ability to manage your time and deadlines independently.
  • UX/UI background;
  • Motion design or video editing (even basic);
  • Experience working with developers or low-code tools like Webflow.

Salary & Benefits:

  • USD $2000 (based on experience)
  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere
  • Growth-focused culture with tons of learning opportunities
  • Impact-driven projects with startups solving real problems
  • Friendly, supportive, and transparent environment

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, your work directly impacts fast-moving startups. You’ll have freedom to explore ideas, contribute to strategy, and help shape the future of digital design—all from wherever you are.

How to Apply

If you’re a web designer with a passion for solving complex problems and SaaS products, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Engenheiro de processos
description:
Vaga: Engenheiro(a) de Processos com Viés Tecnológico Sobre a Agile7
A Agile7 opera na fronteira de engenharia tecnológica, integrando automação, robótica e IA para maximizar eficiência operacional, segurança e qualidade em ambientes industriais. Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Processos orientado(a) a dados, com forte viés tecnológico, para desenhar, otimizar e digitalizar processos ponta a ponta. Missão do cargo
Arquitetar e escalar processos industriais/data-driven com automação, instrumentação e analytics, reduzindo variabilidade, custo e lead time, ao mesmo tempo em que assegura compliance, rastreabilidade e segurança operacional. Responsabilidades-chave
Mapear, modelar e otimizar processos (VSM, BPMN, SIPOC) com foco em throughput, FPY, OEE e custo unitário. Projetar controles e automatizações: PLC/SCADA/MES, IIoT, robótica colaborativa, visão computacional e execução sem papel (paperless).
Implementar monitoramento em tempo real (SPC, CEP, control charts) e gêmeo digital (digital twin) para simulação e “what-if”. Construir pipelines de dados de processo (ETL/ELT) integrando MES/ERP/CMMS/Historiadores (OPC UA, MQTT), com data governance. Aplicar analytics/IA: preditivo/prescritivo (controle avançado, manutenção preditiva, detecção de anomalias, otimização multivariável). Sobre a Vaga:

O Coordenador de Logística é responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar a aquisição de bens e serviços relacionados à cadeia de suprimentos, garantindo qualidade, entrega pontual e eficiência de custos. Essa função exige sólidos conhecimentos técnicos em logística para avaliar especificações, negociar com fornecedores e alinhar as atividades de compras às necessidades operacionais e estratégicas.

Ele/Ela se reportará ao Diretor de Compras Sub-Regional e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com as fábricas e os especialistas locais em Compras de Transporte, a fim de garantir a continuidade do fornecimento e a competitividade das licitações dos fornecedores.

Principais Atribuições:

  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver fornecedores estratégicos para operações logísticas (transporte, armazenagem, embalagem, equipamentos e materiais).
  • Realizar análises técnicas e comerciais de propostas para garantir a conformidade com as especificações e padrões de qualidade.
  • Negociar contratos e termos comerciais, visando otimizar o custo total e o prazo de entrega.
  • Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos fornecedores (SLA, qualidade, pontualidade, custo), conduzir análises de negócios e estabelecer ações corretivas conforme necessário.
  • Colaborar com as equipes técnicas e operacionais para garantir que as compras atendam aos requisitos logísticos e de produção.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de compras que reduzam riscos e aumentem a eficiência da cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Manter atualizado o banco de dados de fornecedores e o mapeamento de mercado.
  • Apoiar o processo orçamentário e as premissas de tendências de mercado.
  • Gerenciar os custos logísticos, incluindo planejados versus reais, por cliente/região e como percentual da receita.
  • Acompanhar a legislação.
  • Implementar as melhores práticas; colaborar com colegas para compartilhar conhecimento e aprendizado, impulsionando a melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com operações/fábricas, fornecedores e consultores para otimizar gastos por meio de projetos técnicos.
  • Estabelecer uma rotina de Rastreamento e Acompanhamento: monitorar entregas, reclamações, ocorrências e custos extras, se houver.
  • CRM (Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente) responsável por Incidentes/Reclamações Logísticas.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação em Logística, Administração de Empresas, Engenharia, Comércio Internacional ou áreas afins.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em compras e gestão de suprimentos na área de logística.
  • Conhecimento técnico de processos logísticos, transporte e armazenagem.
  • Sólidas habilidades de negociação e gestão de contratos.
  • Experiência com compra/negociação de fretes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de apresentação e comunicação em espanhol e inglês.
  • Capacidade de influenciar e obter apoio em situações "de linha pontilhada".
  • Compreende as necessidades do negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Analista de Engenharia Pleno - Segurança Hídrica
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar na análise e desenvolvimento de estudos hidrológicos voltados à mitigação dos impactos de estiagens e secas;
  • Realizar o levantamento e monitoramento de indicadores de vazão, precipitação, volume de chuvas e comportamento de rios e barragens;
  • Avaliar e propor fontes alternativas de abastecimento, contribuindo para a elaboração de soluções técnicas e planos de investimento de capital (CAPEX);
  • Monitorar eventos climáticos e hidrológicos, analisando seus impactos sobre as operações da companhia e apoiando a tomada de decisão técnica;
  • Integrar e consolidar informações provenientes de dados de sensoriamento remoto, estudos climáticos, bases meteorológicas e análises de mercado especializadas, como as do Climatempo;
  • Manter comunicação ativa e constante com as frentes operacionais e áreas técnicas, garantindo agilidade e precisão nas ações preventivas e corretivas;
  • Apoiar o planejamento estratégico voltado à segurança hídrica, considerando cenários de estiagem, baixa vazão de rios e mudanças climáticas;
  • Garantir o registro e atualização de dados técnicos, assegurando rastreabilidade e consistência das informações analisadas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Ambiental, Sanitária, Hídrica, Civil;
  • Experiência ou estudos na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia e segurança hídrica;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de geoprocessamento, incluindo ArcGIS e QGIS;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de análise e tratamento de dados, como Microsoft Excel e Power BI;
  • Residir em Belém/PA ou região;
  • Disponibilidade total para viagens nas regiões Norte e Nordeste do país.

Desejável:

  • Desejável formação de pós-graduação ou mestrado na área de recursos hídricos, hidrologia ou engenharia ambiental.

Informações adicionais:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;

  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Senior Front-End Developer | Vue3
description:
About the Role  

We are seeking an experienced Front-End Developer to design and build high-performance, scalable, and secure web applications for complex, data-driven environments. The role involves close collaboration with backend engineers, QA, and design teams to deliver production-grade interfaces using Vue3, TypeScript, and AWS services. 

This position requires strong technical ability in modern JavaScript frameworks, a solid understanding of front-end architecture, and proven experience deploying and maintaining applications in cloud environments.

  • Translate Figma designs into responsive, pixel-perfect, and accessible interfaces.

  • Optimize rendering, caching, and state management for performance and scalability. 
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure reliability and quality. 
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot front-end applications using AWS (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch). 
  • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and sprint planning. 
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of coding standards, documentation, and delivery processes. 

Required Qualifications  

  • Minimum 6 years of professional experience in front-end or full-stack development. 
  • Advanced proficiency with Vue.js (Vue3 + Composition API) and TypeScript. 
  • Hands-on experience deploying and maintaining front-end applications in AWS environments (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, or API Gateway). 
  • Strong understanding of state management tools (Vuex, Pinia) and performance optimization strategies. 
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar). 
  • Proficiency in testing frameworks such as Jest, Vitest, Cypress, or Playwright. 
  • Excellent written and spoken English (B2 level or higher). 

Preferred Skills  

  • Experience in financial, trading, or other data-intensive systems. 
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as C#/.NET, Python, or Node.js. 
  • Understanding of serverless architecture and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK). 
  • Knowledge of real-time data processing, low-latency UI design, or microfrontend architecture. 
  • Experience mentoring junior developers or contributing to technical strategy. 

What We Value  

  • Strong ownership and accountability. 
  • Clean, maintainable, and testable code. 
  • Attention to performance, scalability, and security. 
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within distributed teams. 
  • Curiosity and initiative to continuously learn and improve. 

Why Join  

  • Opportunity to work on complex, cloud-based applications used globally. 
  • Collaboration with high-performing international teams. 
  • Long-term, stable remote position with room for professional growth and technical leadership.

title: Talent Operations Specialist
description:
About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises looking to deploy advanced AI systems. Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at

Role Summary

This role's primary responsibility will be to carry on talents through the selection process, by executing all the operational steps involved. Those might involve scheduling interviews, speaking and negotiating with candidates, reporting collected information and statuses, and interacting with internal stakeholders.

Besides the tasks execution the person in this role will also be pushed to think and work under the scalability mindset, delivering operational efficiency on the ground. The ideal candidate should be able to execute while challenging the status quo, automatizing repeatable processes, streamlining processes, optimizing cross-functional handoffs, reducing SLAs and improving talents’ experience.

Core Responsibilities

  • Operational Execution : Manage all candidate-related operational steps, including communication via email, WhatsApp, and phone; scheduling technical and client interviews; conducting non-technical interviews; coordinating availability; negotiating rates; and ensuring smooth onboarding transitions.
  • Stakeholder Communication : Provide clear, timely updates and handoffs through shared documents, chat channels, and meetings while keeping candidates informed, engaged, and aware of next steps and feedback throughout the process.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting : Collect, clean, and analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities; monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service-level agreements (SLAs) to maintain high operational standards.
  • Process Optimization : Continuously evaluate and refine workflows to improve scalability and candidate experience, develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Bandwidth & Pipeline Management : Manage large candidate pipelines daily by effectively prioritizing tasks, coordinating with stakeholders, and maintaining consistent productivity and quality under high-volume conditions.
  • Organization & Documentation : Maintain structured, accurate, and up-to-date spreadsheets, trackers, and operational documentation to ensure data integrity and transparency across all processes.
  • Compliance & Risk Management : Adhere to company policies, process playbooks, and quality standards, while supporting audits and reporting efforts to ensure full compliance with organizational and industry regulations.
  • Adaptability & Collaboration : Operate effectively in dynamic, fast-paced environments by switching contexts seamlessly, collaborating across global time zones, and maintaining accountability and clear communication to meet deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s degree in, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, Human Resources or a related field.
  • Experience : 3–6 years at Operations within digital business, or Talent Operations, People Operations, Recruiting Operations, at a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Analytical Skills : Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards); ability to manage databases and process them into reports and insights.
  • Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English), with the ability to convey complex information clearly to both candidates and internal stakeholders.
  • Organization & Prioritization : Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders, and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.
  • Process Orientation : Demonstrated ability to identify inefficiencies, document workflows, and implement process improvements or automation initiatives.
  • Stakeholder Management : Skilled at partnering with recruiters, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams to deliver timely and accurate operational support.
  • Adaptability : Comfortable working across global time zones, shifting priorities, and high-volume pipelines in a dynamic, scaling environment.

Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.

Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone

Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Descrição da vaga

Transforme o futuro com a Minsait

Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.

Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma

Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro

Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.

Engenheiro(a) de Dados (Snowflake / AWS / Databricks)

Profissional com experiência em engenharia de dados voltada para ambiente Snowflake e AWS, atuando desde o discovery até a entrega das soluções. Responsável por modelagem dimensional (fato/dimensão), criação e orquestração de pipelines ELT, otimização de performance (clustering, warehouse sizing) e integrações automatizadas com S3 via Snowpipe.

Desejável domínio em Airflow (ou similar), CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket) e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou CloudFormation). Conhecimentos em Docker/Kubernetes, boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados, e ferramentas de DataOps/Observabilidade (Great Expectations, dbt tests, logging estruturado).

Domínio de Python avançado, PySpark/pandas/Dask e SQL otimizado. Vivência com Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge e CloudWatch na AWS.

Perfil com visão de negócio, capacidade de tradução técnica para stakeholders, resiliência, ownership e forte colaboração em squads multidisciplinares.

Nível de Experiência Desejado:

Sênior

TRABALHE NA MINSAIT

  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Assistência Odontológica com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

Role Overview

We’re seeking detail-oriented candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You’ll read, summarize, and analyze complex content, validate claims through online research, and collaborate with Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve their performance.

Your work will directly contribute to refining cutting-edge AI systems (like Gemini) — no prior AI experience required — a great opportunity to build expertise in the growing field of AI.

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • You will be assisting with screening and training the others need to be Google account users (uses some combination of Gmail, Youtube, Gemini, Search, Photos) willing to use their personal accounts for this eval (can redact any personal information they are not willing to share)

Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.

  • No AI experience required.
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.

  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. • Aplicação de auditorias e revisões periódicas nos processos internos.

4. Relatórios e Comunicação com Órgãos Reguladores

• Elaboração de relatórios ou apresentações periódicas para utilização interna ou externa da empresa, apresentando os apontamentos recebidos, bem como o plano de ação adotado.

• Comunicação de operações suspeitas para entidades reguladoras.

• Manutenção de registros e documentação de compliance.

5. Atualização Regulatória e Treinamentos

• Acompanhamento das emissões e/ou mudanças nas novas regulamentações na legislação, avaliando e definindo junto as áreas envolvidas o cumprimento e as ações necessárias para manter a empresa compliance com as regulamentações.

• Desenvolvimento e atualização dos manuais de compliance, acompanhamento dos vencimentos das políticas, atuando junto as áreas para garantir a conformidade e adequação as regras definidas.

title: Product Designer Senior
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️

About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Senior experience: 7+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a senior product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Front End Developer - Senior/Lead/Architect - Brazil
description:

  • Lead and own the front-end architecture and design of scalable, high-performance web applications.
  • Develop and maintain applications using ReactJS, TypeScript, Hooks, Context API , and Redux/Flux patterns.
  • Design responsive, modular, and reusable UI components using frameworks like Material UI , Bootstrap , or Tailwind .
  • Work closely with backend and DevOps teams to ensure seamless CI/CD integration (preferably on Azure DevOps ).
  • Implement secure front-end integrations with Azure AD B2C or equivalent identity systems.
  • Use SVG and D3.js for advanced data visualizations (annotations, charting, and reporting).
  • Collaborate with product, design, and data teams to translate complex requirements into intuitive, performant UI solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

  • ReactJS , TypeScript , Context API , Hooks , and Redux/Flux patterns
  • HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+)
  • Solid understanding of Node.js concepts and front-end build pipelines.
  • Strong experience with responsive design frameworks (React Material, Bootstrap, Tailwind).
  • Hands-on experience with SVG and D3.js for visualizations.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Familiarity with security best practices , OAuth2 , and Azure B2C authentication.
  • Strong debugging, optimization, and performance tuning skills.
  • 100% hands-on coding; ability to set architectural standards and lead by example.

Preferred Technologies

  • React Material Design
  • SVG / D3.js for data-driven UI
  • Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
  • Azure B2C for authentication and user management
  • React Router , Functional Components , and React Hooks

Who You Are

  • A technical leader who enjoys hands-on coding and architectural problem-solving.
  • Passionate about creating elegant, maintainable, and scalable UI systems.

  • Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional, global teams.

Benefits

  • Health insurance for employee and family.
  • Two weeks of vacation + one week of sick leave annually.
  • Work-from-anywhere flexibility (Brazil only).
  • Annual performance bonus and salary revision.

Equal Opportunity

Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Como Estagiário(a) em produção de conteúdo do nosso departamento de Comunicação e Marketing , você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias, desempenhando um papel crucial no desenvolvimento de estudos, programas e projetos socioeconômicos.

Quem somos

title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

  • Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong Azure and DevOps experience to design, deploy, and support data infrastructure for our retail applications. The ideal candidate will combine data engineering skills with cloud automation and DevOps practices to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability in Azure.

This role is hybrid based in Sao Paulo on a contractual-basis, full-time hours, projected to be a year long, and for a global IT consulting firm.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain data and cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for data and application deployments.
  • Support SQL databases and BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Automate cloud provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (Python, PowerShell).
  • Manage and monitor resources in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and other Azure services.
  • Implement and maintain alerting and monitoring (Azure Monitor, Grafana).
  • Ensure security, performance, and cost optimization of cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with developers and business teams to align DevOps and data practices with business needs.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 8–10+ years of IT experience with strong Azure Cloud and DevOps background.
  • Hands-on experience with AKS , VMs, networking, and Azure databases.
  • Strong SQL and data integration experience (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS) OR similar BI reporting tools .
  • Proficiency in Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Terraform , Azure DevOps , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization ( Docker/Kubernetes ) and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiar with cloud security and disaster recovery practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) is a plus.
  • Experience in the retail energy (power & gas) industry is an advantage.

If this job description aligns with you - or someone who you know is qualified - please attach your most updated CV/resume in English with a good phone number to reach you at . You can also email it to my colleague, . He will send you a call and give you the details in-length!

Best regards,

Brian Scott

title: Estagiário em Planejamento

As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!

title: Engenheiro de software líder
description:
Software Engineering Lead

Esstamos em busca de um(a) Software Engineering Lead , cuja missão será liderar o ciclo de vida completo do desenvolvimento, desde a análise funcional e definição técnica até a implementação e manutenção. Sendo responsável por garantir a arquitetura, qualidade e escalabilidade das soluções desenvolvidas em .NET, GoLang e Web, além de orientar um time de engenheiros, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.

Principais responsabilidades?

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções de software de alta qualidade, confiáveis, escaláveis e com alto desempenho.
  • Analisar requisitos funcionais e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas eficientes e entregáveis claros.
  • Manter a documentação técnica atualizada, incluindo manuais de usuário e documentação de arquitetura e design.
  • Realizar testes unitários e de integração, além de participar ativamente de revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e aderência às diretrizes do departamento.
  • Criar e manter rotinas de teste funcional e de desempenho para microserviços.
  • Oferecer manutenção contínua e suporte técnico às aplicações existentes.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e solucionar desafios técnicos complexos.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, liderando tecnicamente o time de engenheiros, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para o crescimento técnico da equipe.

O que buscamos em você?

Procuramos alguém comprometido com a excelência, ademais:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mais de 10 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software e liderança técnica de projetos e equipes.

  • Forte conhecimento em design de software, padrões de projeto (design patterns) e arquitetura de microserviços.

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend com React , Angular ou outros frameworks modernos .
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de mensageria ( RabbitMQ , Kafka ).
  • Domínio de Git para controle de versão e familiaridade com ambientes cloud (preferencialmente Microsoft Azure ).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ( Scrum , Kanban ) e ferramentas como Jira .
  • Desejável nível intermediário de espanhol e inglês

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time

Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.

We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.

This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle

What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer

Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.

Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Van Hessen is one of the leading global players in the sourcing, processing and distribution of natural casings, meat products and pharmaceuticals. We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.

About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.

About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing organisation would be advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.

Location Requirement

You must live within commutable distance of our Barreiros, São José - SC, , Brazil office as weekly onsite presence is required.

If this sounds like a role that you would be interested in, then we would love to hear from you. To apply, please email a copy of your CV, along with a cover letter explaining the key attributes that you could bring to the role.

We value the support recruitment agencies provide, however we are unable to accept speculative CV’s from agencies we are not already engaged with.

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN

About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.

What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.

Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.

Criação de pipelines de transformação de dados utilizando AWS Glue e PySpark.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Universidade de São Paulo (USP), Tecnológico de Monterrey (ITESM), Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM) and Universidad de los Andes. Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.

  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

Nosso time de Risco de Crédito é o guardião da nossa tese de investimento. Somos responsáveis por construir um portfólio de crédito que seja, ao mesmo tempo, resiliente, rentável e transformador, garantindo a confiança do capital que financia a agricultura do futuro.

Procuramos um profissional que transcenda a análise tradicional. Alguém que não apenas avalie o risco, mas que o modele. Que não apenas utilize ferramentas de IA, mas que seja um parceiro intelectual na sua evolução, escalando nossa capacidade de tomar decisões de crédito mais inteligentes e rápidas.

Sua Missão nos Primeiros 12 Meses

Seu sucesso será medido pela sua capacidade de atuar com excelência na análise de novas operações e no monitoramento rigoroso da carteira, entregando resultados concretos:

  • Análise de Risco Estratégica: Estruturar e defender no Comitê de Crédito um pipeline de operações alinhadas à tese de investimento dos nossos veículos FIDC e CRA, contribuindo diretamente para a meta de alocação de capital da companhia.
  • Monitoramento de Portfólio 360°: Garantir a saúde e a performance de 100% da carteira ativa, através de um sistema de monitoramento proativo que antecipe riscos e assegure o cumprimento rigoroso de todos os covenants financeiros e, crucialmente, ESG.
  • Eficiência e Automação: Liderar a frente de otimização de processos na esteira de crédito, colaborando com a equipe de IA para atingir 80% de automação, liberando tempo da equipe para análises mais estratégicas e aumentando o throughput de operações.
  • Reporting e Governança: Assegurar 100% de acuracidade e pontualidade nos relatórios de risco para o Comitê de Crédito, Diretoria e investidores dos nossos fundos.
Responsabilidades-Chave

1. Análise e Estruturação de Crédito ( Underwriting )

  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras (Balanço Patrimonial, DRE, Fluxo de Caixa) de grandes produtores rurais e grupos econômicos.
  • Modelar a capacidade de pagamento e o fluxo de caixa dos projetos, considerando cenários de estresse de produtividade e preço de commodities.
  • Analisar a estrutura de garantias (imóveis rurais, CPRs, etc.) em colaboração com a equipe Jurídica para garantir a robustez e exequibilidade.
  • Realizar diligência completa utilizando ferramentas de mercado (ex: AgRisk, Serasa, JusBrasil) e fontes de dados alternativas.
  • Elaborar pareceres de crédito ( Investment Memos ) detalhados, com análise profunda de riscos e mitigantes, para apresentação e defesa no Comitê de Crédito.

2. Gestão de Portfólio e Monitoramento

  • Acompanhar a saúde financeira dos produtores da carteira através de relatórios periódicos e análises de safra.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento de covenants socioambientais, utilizando ferramentas de sensoriamento remoto e outras tecnologias para verificar a aderência às práticas de agricultura regenerativa acordadas.
  • Identificar sinais de alerta precoce ( early warning signs ) e propor ações proativas de mitigação de risco.
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de recebimento e liberação de garantias conforme a amortização das operações.

3. Estratégia de Risco e Inovação em IA

  • Auxiliar na definição e aprimoramento contínuo das políticas de crédito da AgDev.
  • Atuar como product owner do ponto de vista de Risco no desenvolvimento e backtesting de modelos de IA, fornecendo feedback contínuo para a equipe de tecnologia.
  • Manter o CRM (Pipedrive) e outros sistemas atualizados com o status de risco e as informações relevantes de cada operação. 17
Perfil Ideal
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 2-3 anos com análise de crédito e risco no agronegócio. Experiência em bancos, fundos (FIDC), securitizadoras ou agfintechs é fortemente preferencial. Experiência comprovada com a análise de crédito para grandes produtores rurais e grupos econômicos complexos.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Domínio profundo de análise financeira, contabilidade rural e modelagem. Domínio da estrutura e do fluxo operacional de instrumentos de dívida do agronegócio, especialmente FIDC e CRA.
  • Análise fundiário-ambiental de imóveis rurais: familiaridade com análise de imóveis rurais.
  • Garantias: Familiaridade avançada com os principais instrumentos de crédito e garantias do agro (CPR-F, Alienação Fiduciária de Imóvel Rural, Hipoteca Rural).
  • Ferramentas: Experiência prática com ferramentas de análise de risco (ex: AgRisk), Excel avançado e CRM (Pipedrive é um diferencial). Familiaridade com plataformas de sensoriamento remoto é um grande diferencial.
  • Mentalidade de IA: Entusiasmo e curiosidade para usar, testar e ajudar a construir tecnologia de ponta para escalar e aprimorar processos de risco.
Soft Skills Essenciais
  • Ownership (Dono): Tratar o portfólio de crédito como seu próprio capital, sentindo-se pessoalmente responsável pela sua performance e resiliência.
  • Proatividade e Autonomia: Antecipar necessidades, iniciar ações e resolver problemas com independência, colaborando intensamente com equipes multidisciplinares (Comercial, Jurídico, IA).
  • Comunicação Clara: Capacidade de sintetizar análises complexas em recomendações claras, objetivas e defensáveis para uma audiência sênior (C-level e investidores).
  • Resiliência: Lidar bem com a pressão e a complexidade de múltiplas operações simultâneas, mantendo um alto padrão de qualidade e atenção aos detalhes.
Por que a AgDev?
  • Impacto: Atuação direta na promoção da agricultura regenerativa e na redução do desmatamento, gerando valor ambiental e financeiro.
  • Tecnologia: Time ágil, com uso intensivo de tecnologia e IA para escalar o impacto, reduzir a burocracia e tomar decisões mais inteligentes.
  • Cultura de Alta Performance: Um ambiente que combina agilidade de startup com a disciplina de uma gestora de ativos. Utilizamos metodologias como Scaling Up e 3HAG para garantir um crescimento estruturado.
  • Exposição a Capital Internacional: Oportunidade única de trabalhar na estruturação de operações financiadas por investidores globais.
  • Crescimento: Oportunidades reais de crescimento e aprendizado contínuo em um modelo de negócio disruptivo e em rápida expansão.
  • Time: Equipe sênior, experiente e altamente colaborativa, com uma cultura digital e direta.
Próximos Passos

Se você acredita que crédito, tecnologia e sustentabilidade podem transformar o agronegócio e quer liderar essa revolução, envie seu currículo e um breve parágrafo descrevendo um exemplo de uma operação de crédito agro complexa que você analisou, destacando os principais riscos e as mitigantes que você estruturou.
